Ask an AI model to judge suggested keyword merges

Source: R/keyword_review.R
ask_ai.Rd

Sends the pairs from [suggest_merges()], with example titles, to a language model, which says for each pair whether the two keywords are the `same` concept, `different` ones, or it is `unsure`, with a name, how sure it is (0 to 1) and why.

Works with any OpenAI-compatible server (OpenAI, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq, Mistral, a local Ollama or LM Studio) and with Anthropic. Without a `url`, a `model` starting with `claude` goes to Anthropic, one starting with `gemini` to Google's Gemini API, anything else to OpenAI. Gemini Nano runs only inside Chrome and Android, so R cannot reach it; Gemma 3n, Google's open model built like it, runs locally through Ollama: `model = "gemma3n", url = "http://localhost:11434/v1"`.

Pairs go 20 to a request, or 5 to a local server (`localhost`): small local models lose track in long lists and answer every pair alike.

Unanswered pairs are asked again each time you call `ask_ai()` on its result, so an interrupted or failed run simply continues. In an interactive session it says how many requests it will send and asks first.

Usage

ask_ai(x, model, key = NULL, url = NULL, instructions = NULL, again = NULL)

Arguments

x

A [suggest_merges()] result, or an earlier `ask_ai()` result.

model

The model's name, e.g. `"gpt-5-mini"`, `"claude-haiku-5-5"`, `"gemini-3-flash"`, `"gemma3n"`.

key

Your API key. Default: `OPENAI_API_KEY`; `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` for Anthropic; `GEMINI_API_KEY` (or `GOOGLE_API_KEY`) for Gemini. Leave empty for a local server. It is never saved.

url

The server, for anything other than OpenAI or Anthropic, e.g. `"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"` or `"http://localhost:11434/v1"`.

instructions

Anything the model should know, in plain words, e.g. `"The papers are on chatbots in education. Prefer AI to ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE."` Without it the model works out the field from the titles.

again

Ask again about pairs the AI already judged, e.g. `again = "unsure"` with a stronger `model`.

Value

`x` with `ai_verdict`, `ai_name`, `ai_confidence` and `ai_reason` filled in, and `decision`: `accept` when the AI said `same` and was at least 80% sure, `reject` when it said `different` and was at least 80% sure, `check` otherwise. `keywords_clean(replace = x)` applies the accepted pairs as they are; [review_sheet()] lets you overrule them. A pair whose answer could not be read is `failed` and is asked again next time.

Errors

Raises `saqrmisc_bad_input` for a missing `model` or key; `saqrmisc_missing_package` without httr2 or jsonlite; `saqrmisc_ai_failed` when the first request fails (wrong key, model or server). A later failure, or stopping the run, warns `saqrmisc_ai_failed` and keeps the answers so far.

See also

[suggest_merges()], [review_sheet()]

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
merges <- suggest_merges(cleaned)
merges <- ask_ai(merges, model = "gpt-5-mini")
merges <- ask_ai(merges, model = "claude-haiku-5-5",
                 instructions = "The papers are on chatbots in education.")
merges <- ask_ai(merges, model = "gemini-3-flash")
merges <- ask_ai(merges, model = "gemma3n", url = "http://localhost:11434/v1")
merges <- ask_ai(merges, model = "claude-sonnet-5-5", again = "unsure")
merges
} # }
